name: William Miller
role: Minnesela, Dakota, man seeking strayed horses
bio: William Miller of Minnesela, Butte County, advertised in the Cow Boy in December 1884 for horses that had strayed on Grand river. In January 1885 the paper cited his case in an editorial comment.

moments.label: Paper commented on his lost-horse case
